## After the Electron Moves

A sodium atom has equal numbers of protons and electrons, so it is neutral. Then it loses one electron to chlorine.

**Predict:** What is the charge on the sodium particle now?

options.text: Zero, because an atom of sodium is always neutral.
+1, because it now has one more proton than it has electrons.
−1, because it lost something, so it must be left with a minus.
